programme.title: 古典樂導賞團 #11
Classical Destinations: The Great Composers #11
programme.sub-title: The great classical composers possessed the enviable talents to express themselves in music, often with great emotion and passion. But they were also ordinary
programme.desc: The great classical composers possessed the enviable talents to express themselves in music, often with great emotion and passion. But they were also ordinary people who experienced the highs and lows that life brought them. Thankfully for us, many of these experiences produced the music that we know and love so much today. This second series of Classical Destinations – The Great Composers explores the lives and times of 26 of classical music’s most creative geniuses, and the stories behind the compositions that continue to engage listeners today. Some enjoyed long and productive careers, some struggled to find their voices, and one or two had very little success while they were alive, but have since been embraced by modern audiences. Nevertheless, all left behind remarkable legacies of memorable music that will go on enduring through the ages.

programme.desc: The series follows Chefs Rob Rossi and Craig Harding as they travel to incredible and often overlooked regions of Italy. From the ancient wonders of Sardinia, to the seaside delights of Naples, to the beauty of Tuscany and more, the Chefs meet local farmers and artisans, experience delicious food made with methods passed down through generations, and use fresh local ingredients from the sea and soil to put their own spin on classic Italian dishes.

programme.desc: The great classical composers possessed the enviable talents to express themselves in music, often with great emotion and passion. But they were also ordinary people who experienced the highs and lows that life brought them. Thankfully for us, many of these experiences produced the music that we know and love so much today. This second series of Classical Destinations – The Great Composers explores the lives and times of 26 of classical music’s most creative geniuses, and the stories behind the compositions that continue to engage listeners today. Some enjoyed long and productive careers, some struggled to find their voices, and one or two had very little success while they were alive, but have since been embraced by modern audiences. Nevertheless, all left behind remarkable legacies of memorable music that will go on enduring through the ages.

programme.desc: This follows one of Ireland’s bloodiest and most notorious crimes. On the 30th March 2005, police were called to the banks of Dublin’s Royal Canal after reports of body parts found floating in the water. Detectives arrived on the scene and began their investigation which brought them across the globe, and ultimately to the door of the Mulhall family. Linda and Charlotte Mullhall, dubbed the “Scissor Sisters” due to the barbarity of the crime, stabbed and dismembered their mother’s partner, Farah Swaleh Noor and dumped his headless body into the canal. The crime horrified yet captivated the nation. This docu-series forensically examines this crime, along with the aftermath that it left in its wake.

programme.sub-title: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?”

He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?”

programme.title: 今日說法
Legal Report
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程”的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓”為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評”的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐”。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。
The rule of law project

programme.title: 八千里路雲和月 1
TV Drama
programme.desc: 是由卞智弘、吳楠、田雨編劇,王陽、萬茜、黃澄澄領銜主演,于和偉特別出演,畢彥君、王和等主演,張桐、丁柳元友情主演,曹磊特邀出演,蘇青出演的年代情感生活反戰劇。該劇以抗日戰爭時期為背景,講述了國民黨抗日將軍張雲魁因上級指揮不當導致全軍覆沒,在張雲魁的幫助之下孟萬福僥倖存活。為此,心灰意冷的將軍將一家老小交付給孟萬福照料,自己則投身游擊隊伍加入救亡圖存的洪流之中。最終抗戰取得勝利,守得雲開見月明的故事。
TV Drama

programme.title: 今日說法
Legal Report
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程”的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓”為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評”的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐”。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。
The rule of law project

programme.title: 八千里路雲和月 3
TV Drama
programme.desc: 是由卞智弘、吳楠、田雨編劇,王陽、萬茜、黃澄澄領銜主演,于和偉特別出演,畢彥君、王和等主演,張桐、丁柳元友情主演,曹磊特邀出演,蘇青出演的年代情感生活反戰劇。該劇以抗日戰爭時期為背景,講述了國民黨抗日將軍張雲魁因上級指揮不當導致全軍覆沒,在張雲魁的幫助之下孟萬福僥倖存活。為此,心灰意冷的將軍將一家老小交付給孟萬福照料,自己則投身游擊隊伍加入救亡圖存的洪流之中。最終抗戰取得勝利,守得雲開見月明的故事。
TV Drama

programme.desc: 是由楊紫領銜主演,胡歌特別出演,李光潔、張哲華領銜主演,梅婷、袁弘、楊爍、周遊友情出演,金巴、馮兵、更旦、蘇鑫、宋楚炎、周放、周思羽、索朗旺姆共同主演的現實主義題材電視劇 。該劇取材於真實事蹟,以虛構的1996年青海省瑪治縣為故事背景,講述了女警白菊加入巡山隊後,與副縣長多傑共同致力於打擊盜獵盜採活動,建立自然保護區。巡山隊經歷多傑失蹤、解散與重組,十多年後白菊與舊友追查多傑失蹤真相,守護青藏高原生態平衡的故事。
TV Drama

programme.title: 我的山與海 1
TV Drama
programme.desc: 是由譚鬆韻領銜主演,董晴、奚望、高至霆主演,王勁松、劉威特邀主演,石雲鵬、趙志偉、王千果、邊程、曲哲明、任帥、郭鵬、戴向宇主要演員,童蕾、胡小庭、徐筠友情出演,馬德鍾、趙亮、黃璐、劉園媛、盧琳特別演出的時代女性勵志劇。該劇根據樑曉聲的原著《我和我的命》改編,講述了“70後”女孩方婉之在遭遇家庭與情感變故後,從貴州輾轉來到深圳創業,憑藉持續學習與不懈努力,完成從“被動承命”到“主動立命”的精神蛻變,最終實現自我價值的故事。
TV Drama

programme.title: 山河錦繡 24
TV Drama
programme.desc: 是由李乃文、王雷、胡明、顏丙燕、姜冠南、趙傑 、蘇青、張嘉益、丁勇岱、馬少驊、張志堅、王子瑜等主演的脫貧攻堅劇。該劇講述了20世紀90年代初的中西部山區,趙、柳兩個不同姓氏的村莊因為一場天災合併成一個村子,村支書趙書和對貧困現狀痛心疾首,一心想改變家鄉貧困的面貌,同時,他還要處理好與以柳大滿為代表的柳氏村民之間關係的故事。

Legal Report
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程”的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓”為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評”的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐”。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

Luxury Escapes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 金馬倫和荷莉結伴到希臘聖托里尼旅遊。這裏一年有二百五十日陽光普照,是個優美怡人的度假勝地。他們下榻於Nobu旗下的豪華酒店。然後再去伊亞另一酒店,觀賞日落美景。

Cameron Daddo and Holly Kingston travel together to Santorini, an idyllic location in Greece that enjoys 250 days of sunshine a year. They stay at the Nobu Hotel Santorini, have dinner at a dining room on top of a cliff and have
programme.desc: a good time on the Caldera. Then they stay at the Santo Pure in Oia, which has the best sunsets in Santorini.

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性美洲[英]
Pearl Spectacular:The Americas[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 陸與水在墨西哥灣沿岸交會。母鱷在沼澤幫幼鱷學習捕獵;大沼澤地的福壽螺奮力避開魚群產卵;馬可島的穴鴞適應近郊生活;刺灌叢的雌性豹貓撫育幼崽。這些故事都展現出該處野生動物的生命力。

The Gulf Coast is a world where land and water meet. In Okefenokee, an alligator mother helps her hatchlings hunt. In the Everglades, apple snails protect eggs above water from hungry fish. On Marco Island,
programme.desc: burrowing owls adapt to suburbia. In Texas thornscrub, a rare mother ocelot raises her kittens. Together, these stories reveal the resilience of Gulf Coast wildlife.

programme.title: 奇珍異獸[英]
Extraordinary Animals[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 攻擊性行為並非僅限於那些最顯而易見的罪魁禍首。本集將探索一些令人驚訝的行為,並闡明訴諸武力對於生存至關重要。本集介紹的動物包括樹熊、小藍企鵝、孔雀螳螂蝦、道森氏掘穴蜂、鳳頭鸚鵡和小丑魚。

Aggressive behaviour is not limited to the most obvious culprits. Exploring some surprising behaviour and illustrating that forceful strategies can be necessary for survival, this episode features koalas, fairy penguins,
programme.desc: peacock mantis shrimps, Dawson's burrowing bees, cockatoos and clownfish.

My Greatest Dishes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 二十多年來,羅斯瑪麗施拉格一直是英國最受歡迎的電視廚師之一。作為一位頗有成就的作家和烹飪老師,她經常出現在受歡迎的節目中,以及她對生活和食物的熱情態度,使她家喻戶曉。

Rosemary Shrager has been one of Britain's best loved TV chefs for over two decades. An accomplished author and cookery teacher, her regular appearances in popular shows, and her enthusiastic approach to life and food, have
programme.desc: made her a household name. Today she cooks her four greatest dishes.

programme.title: 藍海世界[英]
Blue World[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 精彩潛水不限於在礁脈或日間. 攝製隊一分為二, 分別到佛羅里達及夏威夷夜潛, 見到很多在夜間活動的生物. 接著他們到訪魔鬼之泉系統, 探索高流量洞穴潛水, 發現游進去非常費勁, 返回入口則快得多.

Not all the great diving is on the reef, or during the day! The crew divide up into two teams, heading to Florida and Hawaii separately, to experience night dives. At night, all types of interesting creatures come up from the depths.
programme.desc: Then they head to Devil's Spring system to explore a high-flow cave that requires incredible effort to swim up inside. Going back to the entrance is a lot quicker.

programme.title: 明珠雜誌[英]
Pearl Magazine[Eng]
programme.sub-title: Amid Hong Kong's aging population, there are more and more old people living alone in their twilight years. Many of them can feel lonely. But in this final stage of life, those without relatives and living all by themselves can
programme.desc: still feel the warmth of the community, receiving care and help where necessary.

programme.title: 環保鐵路遊[英]
Manchan's Europe by Train[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 曼肯第三段旅程的第一站是克羅地亞,他先去探索首都薩格勒布,然後坐熱氣球觀賞美景。接著他坐火車到斯洛文尼亞划艇,並拜訪熱誠的養蜂人。最後一站是意大利,他獲邀悠然享用美味午餐。

Manchn's first destination on the third leg around Europe is Croatia where he goes inland to explore the beautiful capital city of Zagreb before taking to the skies in a hot air balloon for incredible views. Then he
programme.desc: takes a train to Lake Bled in Slovenia, where he tests his rowing skills, and meets a passionate beekeeper and his colourful hives. Final stop is Italy where he has a long lazy lunch.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 今集是全體淘汰賽, 除了獲豁免的費奧, 人人穿黑圍裙. 挑戰由這大賽的傳奇人物茱莉古雲所定. 她帶來了海鮮鍋. 參賽者要輪流猜測鍋裡一種材料. 最先猜錯的五人將要進入第二回合, 以菜式決定出局人選.

It is an all-in elimination day, and each contestant is wearing a black apron except for Theo who has immunity. The challenge has been set by Julie Goodwin, a MasterChef legend. She has brought in a pot of her seafood stew.
programme.desc: The contestants must take turn to identify an ingredient in Julie's stew. The first 5 people who give a wrong answer will be going through to the Round 2 cook off.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 味覺考驗後, 5人進入第二回合. 早前被淘汰的拉里莎穿上第二次機會圍裙加入戰團, 爭取重回這比賽的機會. 各人要炮製一道美食, 卻只能用茱莉那個海鮮鍋的材料, 沒有檯底主食,食材室及菜園也不開放.

After the taste test, 5 people enter Round 2. And eliminated contestant Larissa will join them cooking for a spot today. She returns in her second chance apron, with the chance to earn her place back in the competition.
programme.desc: They have to prepare the most delicious dish using only the ingredients in Julie's stew, with no under bench. The pantry and the garden are also closed.

programme.title: 鯊魚百科[英]
Shark Dive TV[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 今集,我們將前往南卡羅萊納州的庫珀河尋找巨牙鯊的牙化石。巨牙鯊是已滅絕的耳齒鯊科鯊魚之一,該物種於約 360 萬年前滅絕,被認為是世界上最大的鯊魚。我們還會深入探討巨牙鯊、笠鱗棘鯊和沙虎鯊的特性。

In this episode, we'll go to the Cooper River in South Carolina to find Megalodon Shark teeth. Megalodon is a member of the extinct species of megatooth shark that went extinct around 3.6 million years ago and is considered to be
programme.desc: the largest shark in the world. We'll also take a Deeper Dive with Megalodon Sharks, Prickly Sharks, and Sand Tiger Sharks.

programme.title: 名廚招牌菜[英]
My Greatest Dishes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 二十多年來,羅斯瑪麗施拉格一直是英國最受歡迎的電視廚師之一。作為一位頗有成就的作家和烹飪老師,她經常出現在受歡迎的節目中,以及她對生活和食物的熱情態度,使她家喻戶曉。

Rosemary Shrager has been one of Britain's best loved TV chefs for over two decades. An accomplished author and cookery teacher, her regular appearances in popular shows, and her enthusiastic approach to life and food, have
programme.desc: made her a household name. Today she cooks her four greatest dishes.

programme.title: 節拍小天地[英]
Backyard Beats[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 和Monica一起投入《節拍小天地》。她利用環保回收箱中收集的日常物品,自製手工藝樂器。專業音樂家和少年樂手會到節拍小天地中即興表演。他們的樂器是Monica製作的手工藝樂器的靈感來源。

Join Monica as she builds DIY craft-struments from everyday items that can be found in a recycling bin. Along for the ride are Pro Musicians and Junior Jammers who visit the backyard for a jam session. Their instruments are the
programme.desc: inspiration for Monicas craftstruments builds. Each episode concludes with Monica and her friends making some Backyard Beats!

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性美洲[英]
Pearl Spectacular:The Americas[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 陸與水在墨西哥灣沿岸交會。母鱷在沼澤幫幼鱷學習捕獵;大沼澤地的福壽螺奮力避開魚群產卵;馬可島的穴鴞適應近郊生活;刺灌叢的雌性豹貓撫育幼崽。這些故事都展現出該處野生動物的生命力。

The Gulf Coast is a world where land and water meet. In Okefenokee, an alligator mother helps her hatchlings hunt. In the Everglades, apple snails protect eggs above water from hungry fish. On Marco Island,
programme.desc: burrowing owls adapt to suburbia. In Texas thornscrub, a rare mother ocelot raises her kittens. Together, these stories reveal the resilience of Gulf Coast wildlife.

programme.title: 優遊假期[英]
Luxury Escapes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 金馬倫和荷莉結伴到希臘聖托里尼旅遊。這裏一年有二百五十日陽光普照,是個優美怡人的度假勝地。他們下榻於Nobu旗下的豪華酒店。然後再去伊亞另一酒店,觀賞日落美景。

Cameron Daddo and Holly Kingston travel together to Santorini, an idyllic location in Greece that enjoys 250 days of sunshine a year. They stay at the Nobu Hotel Santorini, have dinner at a dining room on top of a cliff and have
programme.desc: a good time on the Caldera. Then they stay at the Santo Pure in Oia, which has the best sunsets in Santorini.

Manchan's Europe by Train[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 曼肯第三段旅程的第一站是克羅地亞,他先去探索首都薩格勒布,然後坐熱氣球觀賞美景。接著他坐火車到斯洛文尼亞划艇,並拜訪熱誠的養蜂人。最後一站是意大利,他獲邀悠然享用美味午餐。

Manchn's first destination on the third leg around Europe is Croatia where he goes inland to explore the beautiful capital city of Zagreb before taking to the skies in a hot air balloon for incredible views. Then he
programme.desc: takes a train to Lake Bled in Slovenia, where he tests his rowing skills, and meets a passionate beekeeper and his colourful hives. Final stop is Italy where he has a long lazy lunch.

In this episode, travel through the vast ocean to reveal the extraordinary behaviours and remarkable adaptations required for life to survive here. A lionfish is fatally ensnared by a shrimp-like lure; flying fish search for
programme.desc: floating seaweed to lay eggs end up attracting the attention of hungry blue sharks; and South American sea lions raid fishermen's nets with a huge risk.
